meaning:
ἰός, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX: Eze.24:6, 11-12 (חֶלְאָה), Psa.140:3 (חֵמָה), al. ;]
1. an arrow.
2. rust (Ez, l.with): Jas.5:3 (cf. MM, Exp., xv).
3. poison: figuratively, Rom.3:13 (Ps. l.with), Jas.3:8.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”
but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.
